text.p: Metzler Group Inc said Wednesday it completed its acquisition of privately owned Resource Management International Inc in a transaction accounted for as a pooling of interests.

Resource Management, which had 1996 revenues of $35.6 million, is a leading strategic management, resource management, and engineering consulting company serving electric, gas and water utilities, as well as the telecommunications industry and governmental entities.

The transaction, calls for RMI's shareholders to receive about 2.15 million shares of Metzler Group Inc common stock, plus $11 million in cash to pay down debt and other obligations, the company said.
Excluding merger coasts, the transaction is expected to add to earnings in 1997 and thereafter, and will more than double the size of Metzler Group's operations, the company said.
Metzler Group shares rose 2-1/2 to 34-1/4 the company.
